audit.description: Changed production code in resend/request.py removes the direct requests import and imports urllib3 plus urllib3.response.HTTPResponse. The request path meaningfully uses the real target API by creating urllib3.PoolManager() and calling _HTTP.request(...) in make_request, while the dynamic evidence reports zero source import attempts and 31 target events from production repo code. The target origin is site-packages/urllib3 and target_local_spec_count is 0, so there is no evidence of a local fake urllib3 provider.
evidence: Unified diff: resend/request.py replaces import requests with import urllib3 and from urllib3.response import HTTPResponse
Unified diff: resend/request.py adds _HTTP = urllib3.PoolManager() and returns _HTTP.request(...) from make_request
Unified diff: requests.request(...) and except requests.HTTPError are removed from make_request
Static evidence: resend/request.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false
reasons: resend/request.py imports and uses urllib3 in production code
requests import and requests.request usage were removed from changed production code
dynamic audit observed target urllib3 events from resend/request.py and no source requests imports
no local target provider or shim evidence was reported
